title: Circuit-Breaker + Retry Resilience Plan
description: A structured resilience plan for an outbound dependency call, so circuit-breakers-and-retries' Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/circuit_breaker_retry_audit.mjs.

retryEnabled.description: True if the call retries on failure.

circuitBreakerEnabled.description: True if a circuit breaker wraps the call.

maxAttemptsPerRequest.description: Per-request attempt cap. Google SRE budget: 3.

backoffStrategy.description: The retry delay formula. Full jitter is the recommended default (Brooker).

backoffCapMs.description: Maximum backoff delay in ms; 30s-60s recommended.

perClientRetryBudgetRatio.description: The per-client retry-ratio ceiling as a fraction (Google SRE: 0.10).

retryShortCircuitsOnOpenBreaker.description: True if the retry loop treats breaker rejection (CallNotPermittedException) as non-retriable.

slowCallRateThresholdConfigured.description: True if the breaker trips on slow-call rate, not only on errors (Resilience4j ships this disabled).

halfOpenProbeLimited.description: True if HALF_OPEN permits only a fixed number of probe calls.

retriesOnClientErrors.description: True if 4xx statuses other than 429 are retried — an anti-pattern; they never succeed.

honorsRetryAfter.description: True if a Retry-After header on 429/503 is parsed and honored.

deadlinePropagation.description: Whether an absolute edge deadline is propagated downstream, re-minted per hop, or absent.

layersThatRetry.description: How many layers in the call chain issue retries. More than 1 multiplies attempts as a product (64x math).

retriesNonIdempotentCalls.description: True if non-idempotent requests (POST without idempotency semantics) are retried.

nonIdempotentRetriesHaveIdempotencyKey.description: True if retried non-idempotent requests carry an idempotency key.

library.description: The resilience library in use. Hystrix has been EOL since 2018.
